description: Deep protocol architecture deconstruction and unconstrained logic deduction powered by local Qwen3.6-35B MoE. Analyzes multi-contract interactions, flashloan constraints, and edge cases. Charges 0.10 USDC via x402 on Base or eligible points. Supply payer_address. For redemption pass invoice_id and signature in _meta.x402/payment, with tx_hash for on-chain payment or method=points where supported. Settlement errors set isError and _meta.x402/payment-error.status_code; 503 indicates admission unavailable, while a 409 uncertain outcome must not be automatically retried.
